content.text:
Map each node in every diagram on the provided canvas to the source code that implements or explains it.

Read each label in the context of its branch. A node can stand for a single fact, a component, or a flow. Follow it into the source until the code covers what the label describes. When a label names a function, type, or file, include its full declaration. Favor complete coverage over tight ranges; extra surrounding lines are fine, and precision is reviewed in a later step. A node can have several ranges across files.

For large diagrams, assign subtrees to subagents. Each subagent returns mappings for its own nodes. Combine them into one candidate, map any remaining nodes, then validate and submit it yourself. You decide whether and how to split. Use delegate_subagents with several assignments in one call to run them in parallel.

Inputs: the AgentContext contains the pinned, read-only repository checkout and diagram-data.json (ASCII and node references). No layout template or external reference examples are provided. Do not change any diagram’s text or the canvas layout.

Output: return only JSON in this form:
{"diagrams":[{"diagramId":"d1","mappings":[{"node":"n1","path":"relative/file.ts","startLine":10,"endLine":20}]}],"notes":"Unsupported nodes or uncertainty"}
Each entry is one repository-relative, 1-based, inclusive range; repeat a node for multiple ranges. Include every diagram. If you can't support a node, leave it unmapped and say why in notes.

Read ranges with per-file line numbers (for example, nl -ba file) rather than inferring them from search hits. Before returning, call validate_source_mappings with your complete candidate and fix any errors. Your final JSON must match a candidate that passed.

If you receive a subagent assignment, map only the assigned nodes and return their partial mappings and notes using the same JSON shape. You have read/bash tools only; the main agent handles delegation, remaining nodes, validation and final submission.

Subagent assignment (termio):
Map d2 all nodes. Read numbered source ranges, return JSON partial mappings.

1	//! Primary terminal IO ("termio") state. This maintains the terminal state,
     2	//! pty, subprocess, etc. This is flexible enough to be used in environments
     3	//! that don't have a pty and simply provides the input/output using raw
     4	//! bytes.
     5	pub const Termio = @This();
     6	
     7	const std = @import("std");
     8	const assert = @import("../quirks.zig").inlineAssert;
     9	const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator;
    10	const ArenaAllocator = std.heap.ArenaAllocator;
    11	const EnvMap = std.process.Environ.Map;
    12	const posix = std.posix;
    13	const termio = @import("../termio.zig");
    14	const StreamHandler = @import("stream_handler.zig").StreamHandler;
    15	const terminalpkg = @import("../terminal/main.zig");
    16	const global = @import("../global.zig");
    17	const xev = global.xev;
    18	const renderer = @import("../renderer.zig");
    19	const apprt = @import("../apprt.zig");
    20	const internal_os = @import("../os/main.zig");
    21	const windows = internal_os.windows;
    22	const configpkg = @import("../config.zig");
    23	const ProcessInfo = @import("../pty.zig").ProcessInfo;
    24	const compat_file = @import("../lib/compat/file.zig");
    25	
    26	const log = std.log.scoped(.io_exec);
    27	
    28	/// Mutex state argument for queueMessage.
    29	pub const MutexState = enum { locked, unlocked };
    30	
    31	/// Allocator
    32	alloc: Allocator,
    33	
    34	/// This is the implementation responsible for io.
    35	backend: termio.Backend,
    36	
    37	/// The derived configuration for this termio implementation.
    38	config: DerivedConfig,
    39	
    40	/// The terminal emulator internal state. This is the abstract "terminal"
    41	/// that manages input, grid updating, etc. and is renderer-agnostic. It
    42	/// just stores internal state about a grid.
    43	terminal: terminalpkg.Terminal,
    44	
    45	/// The shared render state
    46	renderer_state: *renderer.State,
    47	
    48	/// A handle to wake up the renderer. This hints to the renderer that
    49	/// a repaint should happen.
    50	renderer_wakeup: xev.Async,
    51	
    52	/// The mailbox for notifying the renderer of things.
    53	renderer_mailbox: *renderer.Thread.Mailbox,
    54	
    55	/// The mailbox for communicating with the surface.
    56	surface_mailbox: apprt.surface.Mailbox,
    57	
    58	/// The cached size info
    59	size: renderer.Size,
    60	
    61	/// The mailbox implementation to use.
    62	mailbox: termio.Mailbox,
    63	
    64	/// The stream parser. This parses the stream of escape codes and so on
    65	/// from the child process and calls callbacks in the stream handler.
    66	terminal_stream: StreamHandler.Stream,
    67	
    68	/// Last time the cursor was reset. This is used to prevent message
    69	/// flooding with cursor resets.
    70	last_cursor_reset: ?std.Io.Timestamp = null,
    71	
    72	/// State we have for thread enter. This may be null if we don't need
    73	/// to keep track of any state or if its already been freed.
    74	thread_enter_state: ?*ThreadEnterState = null,
    75	
    76	/// The state we need to keep around only until we enter the IO
    77	/// thread. Then we can throw it all away.
    78	const ThreadEnterState = struct {
    79	    arena: ArenaAllocator,
    80	
    81	    /// Initial input to send to the subprocess after starting. This
    82	    /// memory is freed once the subprocess start is attempted, even
    83	    /// if it fails, because Exec only starts once.
   180	}
   181	
   182	pub const DerivedConfig = struct {
   183	    arena: ArenaAllocator,
   184	
   185	    palette: terminalpkg.color.Palette,
   186	    image_storage_limit: usize,
   187	    cursor_style: terminalpkg.CursorStyle,
   188	    cursor_blink: ?bool,
   189	    cursor_color: ?configpkg.Config.TerminalColor,
   190	    foreground: configpkg.Config.Color,
   191	    background: configpkg.Config.Color,
   192	    osc_color_report_format: configpkg.Config.OSCColorReportFormat,
   193	    clipboard_write: configpkg.ClipboardAccess,
   194	    clipboard_write_limit: usize,
   195	    enquiry_response: []const u8,
   196	    xt_checksum_report: bool,
   197	    xt_checksum_extension: terminalpkg.xt_checksum.Flags,
   198	    conditional_state: configpkg.ConditionalState,
   199	
   200	    pub fn init(
   201	        alloc_gpa: Allocator,
   202	        config: *const configpkg.Config,
   203	    ) !DerivedConfig {
   204	        var arena = ArenaAllocator.init(alloc_gpa);
   205	        errdefer arena.deinit();
   206	        const alloc = arena.allocator();
   207	
   208	        const palette: terminalpkg.color.Palette = palette: {
   209	            if (config.@"palette-generate") generate: {
   210	                if (config.palette.mask.findFirstSet() == null) {
   211	                    // If the user didn't set any values manually, then
   212	                    // we're using the default palette and we don't need
   213	                    // to apply the generation code to it.
   214	                    break :generate;
   215	                }
   216	
   217	                break :palette terminalpkg.color.generate256Color(config.palette.value, config.palette.mask, config.background.toTerminalRGB(), config.foreground.toTerminalRGB(), config.@"palette-harmonious");
   218	            }
   219	
   220	            break :palette config.palette.value;
   221	        };
   222	
   223	        return .{
   224	            .palette = palette,
   225	            .image_storage_limit = config.@"image-storage-limit",
   226	            .cursor_style = config.@"cursor-style",
   227	            .cursor_blink = config.@"cursor-style-blink",
   228	            .cursor_color = config.@"cursor-color",
   229	            .foreground = config.foreground,
   230	            .background = config.background,
   231	            .osc_color_report_format = config.@"osc-color-report-format",
   232	            .clipboard_write = config.@"clipboard-write",
   233	            .clipboard_write_limit = config.@"clipboard-write-limit-bytes".value,
   234	            .enquiry_response = try alloc.dupe(u8, config.@"enquiry-response"),
   235	            .xt_checksum_report = config.@"vt-xt-checksum-report",
   236	            .xt_checksum_extension = xtChecksumFlags(config.@"vt-xt-checksum-extension"),
   237	            .conditional_state = config._conditional_state,
   238	
   239	            // This has to be last so that we copy AFTER the arena allocations
   240	            // above happen (Zig assigns in order).
   241	            .arena = arena,
   242	        };
   243	    }
   244	
   245	    pub fn deinit(self: *DerivedConfig) void {
   246	        self.arena.deinit();
   247	    }
   248	};
   249	
   250	/// Initialize the termio state.
   251	///
   254	pub fn init(self: *Termio, alloc: Allocator, opts: termio.Options) !void {
   255	    // The default terminal modes based on our config.
   256	    const default_modes: terminalpkg.ModePacked = modes: {
   257	        var modes: terminalpkg.ModePacked = .{};
   258	
   259	        // Setup our initial grapheme cluster support if enabled. We use a
   260	        // switch to ensure we get a compiler error if more cases are added.
   261	        switch (opts.full_config.@"grapheme-width-method") {
   262	            .unicode => modes.grapheme_cluster = true,
   263	            .legacy => {},
   264	        }
   265	
   266	        // Set default cursor blink settings
   267	        modes.cursor_blinking = opts.config.cursor_blink orelse true;
   268	
   269	        break :modes modes;
   270	    };
   271	
   272	    // Create our terminal
   273	    var term = try terminalpkg.Terminal.init(global.io(), alloc, opts: {
   274	        const grid_size = opts.size.grid();
   275	        break :opts .{
   276	            .cols = grid_size.columns,
   277	            .rows = grid_size.rows,
   278	            .max_scrollback_bytes = opts.full_config.@"scrollback-limit-bytes".optional(),
   279	            .max_scrollback_lines = opts.full_config.@"scrollback-limit-lines".optional(),
   280	            .default_modes = default_modes,
   281	            .default_cursor_style = opts.config.cursor_style,
   282	            .default_cursor_blink = opts.config.cursor_blink,
   283	            .default_xt_checksum = opts.config.xt_checksum_extension,
   284	            .colors = .{
   285	                .background = .init(opts.config.background.toTerminalRGB()),
